resumen: Sin gestión: no aparece en el directorio

eventos.texto: Clínica Arenal, buenos días, good morning.
Hello, I'd like to be registered as a new patient.
Right,
Falta un segundo dato para abrir la ficha
Could I also have their DNI or NIE, or their date of birth?
It's an NIE 12•••67 X.
May I have the patient's full name, please?
La respuesta ya estaba pensada 1,1 s antes
Andrei Popescu-Zeletin
Let's see,
Let me pull up the record.
Ese DNI no está en el directorio
I can't find that number. Could you read me the DNI again, digit by digit, with the letter at the end?
Ofrece otra forma de identificarse
Could you read me the DNI or NIE slowly, digit by digit, with the letter at the end?
It's an NIE 12•••67•.
Could you also give me the date of birth, please?
La respuesta ya estaba pensada 1,6 s antes
30th of November, 1988
Okay,
Let me pull up the record.
No aparece en el directorio
I'm sorry, I can't find a record with those details. Would you like me to register you as a new patient?
Yes.
Could I have your first surname and your second surname?
Let me check.
Thanks, bye.
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
El planificador declaró un motivo que no tocaba: el núcleo puso el que vio
